Q3_is_v2_more_accurate.question: Is Framework v2 more accurate than Framework v1?

These eliminate the root causes of v1 inaccuracy (forward-scan false positives, wrong-variant targeting, unscanned certifications). Accuracy validation awaits operational data.

Q4_is_v2_reducing_readiness_leakage.verdict: DESIGNED_FOR_SUCCESS — Pre-flight + board visibility rules should reduce leakage from 89.5% to <10%. The v1 leakage legacy (DL-021, DL-016 on Certified items) must be remediated before Phase 2. The 242 BLOCKED + 77 REMEDIATE items at S322 demonstrate how many items the v2 gates would have caught before certification.

Q5_is_v2_reducing_governance_workload.question: Is Framework v2 reducing governance workload?
